author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
How to burn your monthly tokens budget in one day

1. Ask AI an impossible task that sounds do-able
2. /goal it

Opus can implement a working 4004 busicom firmware in Rust. My mistake was ask it to do as good as the genius human engineer who fit it under 1kB.

The Rust version is > 10kB.
